headline: High-risk data leakage and cascading-error pathways exist because Khoj reads personal notes/files while Prefect can orchestrate downstream API actions with broad egress.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Khoj reads indexed personal notes/files and can use web search, so attacker-controlled content could enter its outputs. Prefect has broad network egress and can consume workflow metadata, creating a plausible bridge if Khoj output is reused in workflows. The shared channel is not explicit, so this is medium rather than high.
conditions: IF Khoj ingests untrusted notes or web content into retrieved answers
IF Prefect workflows consume Khoj-generated text as instructions or parameters
mitigations: Disable automatic reuse of Khoj outputs in Prefect flows
Add a manual review step before any workflow execution
Restrict Khoj to trusted note collections only
Tag retrieved content with provenance labels
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization and instruction-stripping between systems

B_data_leakage.rationale: Khoj touches personal notes and indexed documents, while Prefect has broad egress and can call external APIs. If Prefect receives Khoj outputs or shared files, sensitive note content can leave the local environment. The profiles do not show a shared workspace, so medium is the highest supportable severity.
conditions: IF Khoj outputs containing personal notes are passed into Prefect tasks
IF Prefect tasks send workflow payloads to external services
mitigations: Keep Khoj and Prefect on separate workspaces
Block Prefect tasks from receiving raw note text
Review outbound API destinations before runs
Redact personal data before orchestration
requires-engineering: enforce egress allowlists and DLP

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Khoj is read-only on filesystem and does not modify git state, while Prefect's profile exposes only API-calling behavior and no write surface. Overlapping write conflict is not evidenced, so only a small coordination risk remains if both touch shared metadata externally.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external resource
IF Prefect writes workflow metadata derived from Khoj outputs
mitigations: Avoid shared mutable targets
Run Prefect in read-only mode for Khoj-derived inputs
Separate credentials per system
Serialize any shared updates manually

D_cascading_error.rationale: Khoj can generate retrieved answers from notes and documents, and Prefect is an orchestration system that can act on workflow metadata. If Prefect treats Khoj output as authoritative, errors can cascade into downstream actions. Verification is not documented, so medium is warranted.
conditions: IF Prefect uses Khoj output as a trigger or parameter source
IF no human or automated verification step checks Khoj outputs before execution
mitigations: Require approval before Prefect execution
Validate Khoj outputs against source documents
Limit Prefect to non-destructive dry runs
Log provenance for every propagated field
requires-engineering: add schema validation and confidence gating

E_compliance.rationale: Khoj explicitly touches personal notes and indexed documents, which may carry regulated data, while Prefect's profile only shows workflow metadata and no specific residency or certification mismatch. With no documented cross-border or retention conflict, the compliance risk is limited and localized.
conditions: IF personal notes contain regulated data classes
IF Prefect stores workflow metadata derived from those notes in a different retention regime
mitigations: Classify note collections before syncing
Exclude regulated notes from orchestration
Set short retention on workflow metadata
Review vendor data-processing terms
requires-engineering: align residency and retention controls
